name: Blocker Marbles
description: Some boxes are tagged with 3 stone blocker marbles mixed in. Fill the stone tray to shatter them all at once.
howToPlay: Tap the boxes with the stone badge (top of the box) to spawn 6 colored + 3 stone marbles. Colored marbles get sorted normally. Stone marbles fill the Blocker Tray below the belt. When every slot is full, the tray shatters and clears them instantly.
author: Blocker Marbles prototype

showcaseLevel.name: Blocker Marbles — Showcase
showcaseLevel.desc: 3 blocker-tagged boxes (9 stone marbles) + 3 normal boxes.
